newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 rupees up at 41.93 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb market amid high supply of the dollar, dealers said.
They said the rupee might rise further as a rupee shortage had dampened dollar buying while plenty of dollars were flowing in from abroad.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.80 percent, from Monday's close at 5.10 percent.
